notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content: Work was carried out with optimization. Now the load on your graphics card and processor will be less, which will allow you to play more comfortably.

notes.title: Update 1.9
notes.content:
the following changes have been made to this minor update.

1) Fixing artificial intelligence. Now ai will constantly analyze the situation, which will make the gameplay even more fun
2) Big interface update! Some people did not like the interface and style of the game, I decided to fix it. Hope you enjoy the updated interface.
3) Update the menu. Changes were made to the design and arrangement of objects in the scene of the main menu.

notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.content:
Changes have been made to the game.

1) A minimap has been added for the convenience of the player during the game.
On the minimap, you can track your movement and see enemies if they are near you, which can simplify the task for you when passing the game.
2) Update the main menu disinfectant.

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.content:
A new currency "rubles" was added to the game. Rubles fall from the corpses of enemies and you can exchange them at the merchant...

Also added new melodies to the levels and bug fixes in the conflict of enemies.

notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.content:
The following list of changes:
1) Updated interface.
2) Add in-game achievements, now you can try to knock out all the achievements available in the game.
3) Changes in the number of waves. Previously, it was standard to go through 20 waves of zombies, now there are 10 of them and it will be easier for you to pass the game.

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.content:
Multiple changes have been made to the game:

1) Bugs and bugs in the game have been fixed.
2) Automatic reloading has been added for convenience during the game.
3) New maps have been added, a factory and a hospital.

Enjoy your game)

notes.title: Changes were made in the interface, as well as changes in the game balance.
notes.content: Changes have been made to the game interface. Now the menu design looks more attractive. After changes in the game balance, you can pick up 300 from a pack of hryvnias, instead of 250. Such changes will make the game easier for players and make the process more enjoyable.

notes.title: 🎄 Merry Christmas 🎄
notes.content:
🎄 Merry Christmas 🎄
In this update, you'll see:
 New Year's map, where you have to defend Santaklaus, who was knocked out by the air defense of vata zombies.
 A little optimization was also carried out.
